'''Nawaru''', or '''Sirio''', is a [[Papuan languages|Papuan language]]. It is spoken in the village of Sibia ({{coord|-9.437132|148.30083|type:city_region:PG|name=Sibia}}) in Namudi ward, [[Safia Rural LLG]], [[Ijivitari District]], [[Oro Province]], in the "tail" of [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref name=e25/><ref name="UN-PNG">{{cite web |url=https://data.humdata.org/dataset/village-coordinates-lookup |title=Papua New Guinea Village Coordinates Lookup |author=United Nations in Papua New Guinea |work=Humanitarian Data Exchange |version=1.31.9 |date=2018}}</ref>

Nawaru is described by ''[[Ethnologue]]'' as "very similar" to [[Yareba language|Yareba]].<ref name=e25/>
